description: Render a map of the model as an inline image: buses at their coordinates, lines and links between them, and generators (triangles), loads (squares) and storage (diamonds) ringed around their bus. Use it to show the user the network — especially right after edits, to confirm what changed and where. Optionally pass component names to highlight.

highlight.description: Component names (buses, lines, links) to highlight and label.

name: preview_model_map
